references.authors: Afeiche MC, Gaskins AJ, Williams PL, et al.
references.title: Processed meat intake is unfavorably and fish intake favorably associated with semen quality indicators among men attending a fertility clinic
references.finding: Men in the highest category of processed meat intake had 1.7 percentage points fewer normal-shaped sperm; fish intake was associated with better semen quality.

references.authors: Afeiche MC, Williams PL, Gaskins AJ, et al.
references.title: Meat intake and reproductive parameters among young men
references.finding: Processed meat intake was associated with about 78 million fewer sperm per ejaculate in young men, while unprocessed red meat showed no association with any semen measure.

references.authors: Almeida FN, Leray C, Albignac M, et al.
references.title: Py-GC-MS/MS quantification of microplastics in vertebrate tissues: Addressing false positives of polyethylene
references.finding: Method study showing that lipid-derived pyrolysis fragments cause false-positive polyethylene signals in vertebrate tissue, and that using markers longer than C22 raises the limit of quantification to 50 ug/g.

references.authors: Andersson AG, Xu Y, Kärrman A, et al.
references.title: Serum, urinary and fecal concentrations of perfluoroalkyl substances after interventions with cholestyramine/colesevelam and probenecid - cross-over trials in Ronneby, Sweden
references.finding: Cholestyramine raised faecal PFOS excretion 23-fold, and 12 weeks of colesevelam lowered serum PFOS by 38% versus 2% in the control period, with smaller falls for PFHxS and PFOA.

references.authors: Arner P, Bernard S, Salehpour M, et al.
references.title: Dynamics of human adipose lipid turnover in health and metabolic disease
references.n: adipose samples dated by bomb-pulse carbon-14
references.finding: Adipocyte triglycerides are renewed about six times during an adipocyte's roughly 10-year lifespan, giving a lipid age of about 1.6 years that is stable across adult ages.

references.authors: Barn P, Gombojav E, Ochir C, et al.
references.title: The effect of portable HEPA filter air cleaner use during pregnancy on fetal growth: The UGAAR randomized controlled trial
references.finding: HEPA air cleaners used from early pregnancy cut indoor PM2.5 by 29% but did not raise birth weight overall (+18 g), with an 85 g gain limited to term births.

references.authors: Barnoya J, Glantz SA
references.title: Cardiovascular effects of secondhand smoke: nearly as large as smoking
references.finding: Review: secondhand smoke raises coronary heart disease risk about 30%, and even brief exposures produce platelet, endothelial and oxidative effects averaging 80-90% of those of chronic active smoking.

references.authors: Barregard L, Sällsten G, Andersson L, et al.
references.title: Experimental exposure to wood smoke: effects on airway inflammation and oxidative stress
references.finding: A 4-hour exposure to 240-280 ug/m3 wood smoke raised malondialdehyde in exhaled breath condensate and alveolar nitric oxide, indicating airway oxidative stress within hours.

references.authors: Bastide NM, Pierre FH, Corpet DE
references.title: Heme iron from meat and risk of colorectal cancer: a meta-analysis and a review of the mechanisms involved
references.finding: Highest versus lowest heme iron intake carried an 18% higher colon cancer risk, and heme catalyses N-nitrosation and lipid peroxidation to cytotoxic aldehydes in the gut lumen.

references.authors: Berg DD, Jhund PS, Docherty KF, et al.
references.title: Time to Clinical Benefit of Dapagliflozin and Significance of Prior Heart Failure Hospitalization in Patients With Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction
references.finding: Dapagliflozin's reduction in cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure became statistically significant by 28 days after randomization and was sustained.

references.authors: Bingham SA, Hughes R, Cross AJ
references.title: Effect of white versus red meat on endogenous N-nitrosation in the human colon and further evidence of a dose response
references.finding: Faecal N-nitroso compounds rose linearly with red meat from 0 to 420 g/day within days of controlled feeding; the same amount of white meat had no effect and fibre did not reduce them.

references.authors: Bouvard V, Loomis D, Guyton KZ, et al.
references.title: Carcinogenicity of consumption of red and processed meat
references.finding: IARC working group classified processed meat as carcinogenic to humans (Group 1) and red meat as probably carcinogenic (Group 2A), based mainly on colorectal cancer.

references.authors: Brandt EJ, Myerson R, Perraillon MC, et al.
references.title: Hospital Admissions for Myocardial Infarction and Stroke Before and After the Trans-Fatty Acid Restrictions in New York
references.n: 11.7 million adults in New York counties
references.finding: Three or more years after trans-fat restrictions, restricted counties had 6.2% fewer combined myocardial infarction and stroke admissions and 7.8% fewer myocardial infarctions than unrestricted counties.

references.authors: Buchet JP, Lauwerys R, Roels H
references.title: Comparison of the urinary excretion of arsenic metabolites after a single oral dose of sodium arsenite, monomethylarsonate, or dimethylarsinate in man
references.finding: After a single oral dose, 46% of inorganic arsenite and about 75-78% of methylated arsenic was excreted in urine within 4 days, so urinary arsenic reflects only the last few days of intake.

references.authors: Butts CD, Bloom MS, McGough A, et al.
references.title: Toxic elements in follicular fluid adversely influence the likelihood of pregnancy and live birth in women undergoing IVF
references.finding: Follicular-fluid mercury above about 0.51 ug/L and higher lead were associated with lower live birth after IVF (lead RR 0.68).

references.authors: Carwile JL, Ye X, Zhou X, et al.
references.title: Canned soup consumption and urinary bisphenol A: a randomized crossover trial
references.finding: One serving of canned soup daily for 5 days raised urinary BPA from 1.1 to 20.8 ug/L, about a 1,200% increase, versus fresh soup.

references.authors: Casal S, Malheiro R, Sendas A, et al.
references.title: Olive oil stability under deep-frying conditions
references.finding: Under domestic deep-frying, olive oils lasted 24-27 hours before reaching the 25% polar-compound limit versus 15 hours for a PUFA-rich vegetable blend.

references.authors: Chen R, Zhao A, Chen H, et al.
references.title: Cardiopulmonary benefits of reducing indoor particles of outdoor origin: a randomized, double-blind crossover trial of air purifiers
references.finding: Forty-eight hours of real versus sham HEPA purification cut indoor PM2.5 by 57% and lowered myeloperoxidase by 33%, other inflammatory and thrombotic markers, and blood pressure.

references.authors: Chiu YH, Gaskins AJ, Williams PL, et al.
references.title: Intake of Fruits and Vegetables with Low-to-Moderate Pesticide Residues Is Positively Associated with Semen-Quality Parameters among Young Healthy Men
references.finding: Eating at least 2.8 servings a day of low-to-moderate-pesticide-residue fruit and vegetables was associated with 169% higher total sperm count, while high-residue produce was not.

references.authors: Clancy L, Goodman P, Sinclair H, et al.
references.title: Effect of air-pollution control on death rates in Dublin, Ireland: an intervention study
references.n: Dublin, 72 months before and after a coal ban
references.finding: After Dublin's 1990 coal ban cut black smoke by 36 ug/m3, respiratory deaths fell 15.5% and cardiovascular deaths 10.3% in an interrupted time-series analysis.

references.authors: Correia G, Magina S
references.title: Efficacy of topical vitamin C in melasma and photoaging: A systematic review
references.finding: Systematic review of topical vitamin C for melasma and photoageing found modest benefits in small vehicle-controlled trials, typically assessed after 3-6 months.

references.authors: Cowie MR, Fisher M
references.title: SGLT2 inhibitors: mechanisms of cardiovascular benefit beyond glycaemic control
references.finding: Review of proposed mechanisms for SGLT2-inhibitor cardiovascular benefit, including natriuresis, ketone-body fuel shift and reduced oxidative stress, most of which rest on preclinical data.

references.authors: Cox KD, Covernton GA, Davies HL, et al.
references.title: Human Consumption of Microplastics
references.finding: Estimated human microplastic intake of roughly 39,000-52,000 particles a year from food, rising to 74,000-121,000 with inhalation, and up to 90,000 more from bottled water.

references.authors: Cholesterol Treatment Trialists' Collaboration
references.title: Effect of statin therapy on muscle symptoms: an individual participant data meta-analysis of large-scale, randomised, double-blind trials
references.finding: Statins caused a 7% relative excess of muscle symptoms, concentrated in the first year (about 11 excess reports per 1,000 person-years), and over 90% of muscle complaints on statins were not caused by the drug.

references.authors: Cuffney M, Wilkie AA, Kotlarz N, et al.
references.title: Factors associated with per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) serum concentrations in residents of New Hanover County, North Carolina: The GenX exposure study
references.finding: Residents drinking municipal water through a home filter had lower serum levels of all seven PFAS measured than those drinking unfiltered tap water.

references.authors: D'Aiuto F, Gkranias N, Bhowruth D, et al.
references.title: Systemic effects of periodontitis treatment in patients with type 2 diabetes: a 12 month, single-centre, investigator-masked, randomised trial
references.finding: Intensive periodontal treatment lowered HbA1c by 0.6 percentage points versus control treatment at 12 months.

references.authors: da Silva JC, Muniz FWMG, Oballe HJR, et al.
references.title: The effect of periodontal therapy on oxidative stress biomarkers: A systematic review
references.finding: Mechanical periodontal treatment generally lowered oxidative markers such as 8-OHdG and total oxidant status in saliva and gingival fluid, and in serum in most studies.

references.authors: Dayton S, Hashimoto S, Pearce ML
references.title: Adipose tissue linoleic acid as a criterion of adherence to a modified diet
references.n: institutionalized men on a high-linoleic diet
references.finding: Adipose linoleic acid correlated poorly with dietary adherence after 1 year but well after 5-6 years (r 0.81 and 0.74), showing adipose composition integrates intake over years.

references.authors: De Caterina R, Cipollone F, Filardo FP, et al.
references.title: Low-density lipoprotein level reduction by the 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme-A inhibitor simvastatin is accompanied by a related reduction of F2-isoprostane formation in hypercholesterolemic subjects: no further effect of vitamin E
references.finding: Two months of simvastatin lowered LDL cholesterol and urinary F2-isoprostanes, with the fall already present after one month; adding 600 mg/day vitamin E produced no further reduction.

references.authors: de Courten B, de Courten MP, Soldatos G, et al.
references.title: Diet low in advanced glycation end products increases insulin sensitivity in healthy overweight individuals: a double-blind, randomized, crossover trial
references.finding: Two weeks of a low-AGE diet raised insulin sensitivity by 1.3 mg/kg/min on clamp while a high-AGE diet tended to lower it, a between-diet difference of 2.1 mg/kg/min.

references.authors: Delaere I, Harris K, Gaskin S, et al.
references.title: Changes in serum perfluorooctane sulfonic acid and perfluorohexane sulfonic acid concentrations in firefighters accessing a voluntary perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances reduction treatment program
references.finding: Treated firefighters (plasma donation, cholestyramine or both) lost PFOS at 41% per year (apparent half-life 1.2 years) versus 12% per year (7.3 years) in those only observed.

references.authors: Demmer RT, Trinquart L, Zuk A, et al.
references.title: The influence of anti-infective periodontal treatment on C-reactive protein: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
references.finding: Versus no treatment, periodontal therapy lowered CRP by 0.37 mg/L at the earliest post-treatment time point (typically 1-3 months), with larger effects when antibiotics were added.

references.authors: Dethlefsen L, Relman DA
references.title: Incomplete recovery and individualized responses of the human distal gut microbiota to repeated antibiotic perturbation
references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.finding: Ciprofloxacin cut gut diversity within 3-4 days; communities began returning within a week of each course but recovery was incomplete and the final state differed from baseline.

references.authors: Dewalque L, Pirard C, Vandepaer S, et al.
references.title: Temporal variability of urinary concentrations of phthalate metabolites, parabens and benzophenone-3 in a Belgian adult population
references.finding: Within-person reproducibility of urinary biomarkers over 4 months was fair for parabens and short-chain phthalate metabolites (ICC 0.55-0.68) but poor for DEHP metabolites (0.20-0.49).

references.authors: Di Nisio A, López-Gil JF, Pizzol D, et al.
references.title: Associations between per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances and semen parameters: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis
references.finding: Updated meta-analysis: PFAS showed heterogeneous associations with conventional semen measures but consistent inverse associations with progressive motility and consistent associations with higher sperm DNA fragmentation.

references.authors: Dockery DW, Rich DQ, Goodman PG, et al.
references.title: Effect of air pollution control on mortality and hospital admissions in Ireland
references.n: Dublin, Cork and four Irish counties, 1981-2004
references.finding: Extending the analysis to three sequential Irish coal bans found respiratory mortality reductions of 17%, 9% and 3% but no clear reduction in total or cardiovascular mortality.

references.authors: EMPA-KIDNEY Collaborative Group, Herrington WG, Staplin N, et al.
references.title: Long-Term Effects of Empagliflozin in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease
references.finding: After empagliflozin was stopped, its cardiorenal benefit continued for up to about 12 months (post-trial hazard ratio 0.87) before the groups converged.

references.authors: Engebretson SP, Hyman LG, Michalowicz BS, et al.
references.title: The effect of nonsurgical periodontal therapy on hemoglobin A1c levels in persons with type 2 diabetes and chronic periodontitis: a randomized clinical trial
references.finding: A large US trial stopped for futility: non-surgical periodontal therapy improved periodontal measures but did not change HbA1c at 6 months (difference -0.05%).

references.authors: Fennell TR, Sumner SC, Snyder RW, et al.
references.title: Metabolism and hemoglobin adduct formation of acrylamide in humans
references.finding: Oral labelled acrylamide was excreted mostly as glutathione conjugates within days and formed haemoglobin adducts in linear proportion to dose; dermal uptake was about 6.6% of oral.

references.authors: Fisher GJ, Wang ZQ, Datta SC, et al.
references.title: Pathophysiology of premature skin aging induced by ultraviolet light
references.finding: A single UV exposure induced collagenase, gelatinase and stromelysin in human skin and raised collagen breakdown 58%; repeated exposures kept MMP activity raised for 7 days, and tretinoin pretreatment blocked induction by 70-80%.

references.authors: Forchhammer L, Møller P, Riddervold IS, et al.
references.title: Controlled human wood smoke exposure: oxidative stress, inflammation and microvascular function
references.finding: Three-hour controlled exposures to 220-354 ug/m3 of modern wood-stove particles had no effect on oxidatively damaged DNA, inflammatory markers or microvascular function.

references.authors: Frazer K, Callinan JE, McHugh J, et al.
references.title: Legislative smoking bans for reducing harms from secondhand smoke exposure, smoking prevalence and tobacco consumption
references.finding: Cochrane review: national smoking bans consistently improved cardiovascular outcomes, most clearly acute coronary syndrome admissions, with less consistent effects on respiratory and perinatal outcomes.

references.authors: Freedberg DE, Toussaint NC, Chen SP, et al.
references.title: Proton Pump Inhibitors Alter Specific Taxa in the Human Gastrointestinal Microbiome: A Crossover Trial
references.finding: Four weeks of omeprazole 40 mg twice daily did not change overall gut microbial diversity but reproducibly increased Enterococcaceae and Streptococcaceae and decreased Clostridiales.

references.authors: Gasiorowski R, Forbes MK, Silver G, et al.
references.title: Effect of Plasma and Blood Donations on Levels of Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances in Firefighters in Australia: A Randomized Clinical Trial
references.finding: Over 12 months, plasma donation every 6 weeks lowered serum PFOS by 2.9 ng/mL and PFHxS by 1.1 ng/mL and blood donation every 12 weeks lowered PFOS by 1.1 ng/mL, with no change under observation.

references.authors: Gaskins AJ, Fong KC, Abu Awad Y, et al.
references.title: Time-Varying Exposure to Air Pollution and Outcomes of in Vitro Fertilization among Couples from a Fertility Clinic
references.finding: Air pollution exposure during ovarian stimulation, not later stages, carried the strongest association with IVF failure: each interquartile rise in NO2 raised the odds of failing before retrieval by 42%.

references.authors: Goempel K, Tedsen L, Ruenz M, et al.
references.title: Biomarker monitoring of controlled dietary acrylamide exposure indicates consistent human endogenous background
references.finding: Labelled acrylamide was excreted essentially completely as urinary mercapturic acids within 72-96 h, ruling out release from deep body stores; a baseline excretion persisted on an acrylamide-minimised diet, implying endogenous formation.

references.authors: Martínez Góngora V, Matthes KL, Castaño PR, et al.
references.title: Dietary Heterocyclic Amine Intake and Colorectal Adenoma Risk: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
references.finding: Higher intake of the meat-derived heterocyclic amines PhIP and MeIQx was associated with about 20% higher colorectal adenoma risk (OR 1.20 each) with a dose-response, reflecting years of habitual cooking practice.

references.authors: Green A, Williams G, Neale R, et al.
references.title: Daily sunscreen application and betacarotene supplementation in prevention of basal-cell and squamous-cell carcinomas of the skin: a randomised controlled trial
references.finding: Daily SPF 15+ sunscreen did not change the number of people developing basal- or squamous-cell carcinoma but cut squamous-cell tumour rates by 39%.

references.authors: Green AC, Williams GM, Logan V, et al.
references.title: Reduced melanoma after regular sunscreen use: randomized trial follow-up
references.finding: Ten years after trial cessation, the daily-sunscreen group had half as many new melanomas (11 vs 22) and a quarter as many invasive melanomas (3 vs 11).

references.authors: Guallar-Castillón P, Rodríguez-Artalejo F, Lopez-Garcia E, et al.
references.title: Consumption of fried foods and risk of coronary heart disease: Spanish cohort of the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition study
references.finding: In a Mediterranean cohort frying mainly in olive or sunflower oil, fried-food intake was not associated with coronary heart disease (HR 1.08) or mortality.

references.authors: Gulson BL, Mizon KJ, Korsch MJ, et al.
references.title: Mobilization of lead from human bone tissue during pregnancy and lactation--a summary of long-term research
references.finding: Isotope tracing showed the maternal skeleton supplied about a third of blood lead during pregnancy, with a larger release after delivery during lactation, especially on low calcium intake.

references.authors: Guyenet SJ, Carlson SE
references.title: Increase in adipose tissue linoleic acid of US adults in the last half century
references.finding: Systematic review: adipose linoleic acid in US adults rose by 136% over half a century, closely tracking the rise in dietary linoleic acid.

references.authors: Guyuron B, Rowe DJ, Weinfeld AB, et al.
references.title: Factors contributing to the facial aging of identical twins
references.finding: Among identical twins, greater cumulative sun exposure, smoking and higher BMI were associated with looking older, isolating environmental from genetic ageing.

references.authors: Harley KG, Kogut K, Madrigal DS, et al.
references.title: Reducing Phthalate, Paraben, and Phenol Exposure from Personal Care Products in Adolescent Girls: Findings from the HERMOSA Intervention Study
references.finding: Three days of personal-care products labelled free of phthalates, parabens, triclosan and benzophenone-3 lowered urinary monoethyl phthalate by 27%, parabens by about 44% and triclosan and BP-3 by about 36%.

references.authors: Hauser R, Gaskins AJ, Souter I, et al.
references.title: Urinary Phthalate Metabolite Concentrations and Reproductive Outcomes among Women Undergoing in Vitro Fertilization: Results from the EARTH Study
references.finding: Women in the top quartile of urinary DEHP metabolites retrieved fewer oocytes and had about 19 percentage points lower clinical pregnancy and live birth per cycle than the bottom quartile.

references.authors: Heard K, Green JL, Anderson V, et al.
references.title: A randomized, placebo-controlled trial to determine the course of aminotransferase elevation during prolonged acetaminophen administration
references.finding: Of adults taking 4 g/day acetaminophen, 77% had no or only transient ALT elevation by day 16, and 47 of the 48 with raised ALT at day 16 saw it resolve by day 40 while still taking the drug.

references.authors: Hess MW, Hoenderop JG, Bindels RJ, et al.
references.title: Systematic review: hypomagnesaemia induced by proton pump inhibition
references.finding: PPI-induced hypomagnesaemia appeared after a median 5.5 years of use (range 14 days to 13 years), resolved within about 4 days of stopping, and recurred within about 4 days on re-challenge.

references.authors: Hodson L, Eyles HC, McLachlan KJ, et al.
references.title: Plasma and erythrocyte fatty acids reflect intakes of saturated and n-6 PUFA within a similar time frame
references.finding: Switching between high-saturated-fat and high-linoleic-acid diets changed plasma, erythrocyte and buccal fatty acids within the first 2 weeks and then plateaued, with no detectable change in adipose tissue over 16 weeks.

references.authors: Hughes MC, Williams GM, Baker P, et al.
references.title: Sunscreen and prevention of skin aging: a randomized trial
references.finding: Daily broad-spectrum sunscreen produced no detectable increase in skin ageing over 4.5 years and 24% less photoageing than discretionary use; beta-carotene had no overall effect.

references.authors: Huijgen NA, de Ridder MA, Verhamme KM, et al.
references.title: Are proton-pump inhibitors harmful for the semen quality of men in couples who are planning pregnancy?
references.finding: PPI use 6-12 months before semen analysis was associated with threefold higher odds of a low total motile sperm count, while use in the preceding 6 months was not.

references.authors: Humbert PG, Haftek M, Creidi P, et al.
references.title: Topical ascorbic acid on photoaged skin. Clinical, topographical and ultrastructural evaluation: double-blind study vs. placebo
references.finding: A 5% vitamin C cream applied daily improved global clinical score, skin microrelief and deep furrows versus vehicle, with assessments at 3 and 6 months.

references.authors: Hyland C, Bradman A, Gerona R, et al.
references.title: Organic diet intervention significantly reduces urinary pesticide levels in U.S. children and adults
references.finding: Six days of organic food cut urinary levels of 13 pesticide biomarkers, including clothianidin -83%, malathion metabolite -95% and the chlorpyrifos metabolite TCPy -61%.

references.authors: Imhann F, Bonder MJ, Vich Vila A, et al.
references.title: Proton pump inhibitors affect the gut microbiome
references.finding: PPI use was associated with lower gut microbial diversity and changes in 20% of taxa, including more oral bacteria and potential pathogens, an effect larger at population level than antibiotics.

references.authors: Jernberg C, Löfmark S, Edlund C, et al.
references.title: Long-term ecological impacts of antibiotic administration on the human intestinal microbiota
references.n: 4 exposed and 4 control adults over 2 years
references.finding: A 7-day clindamycin course caused a sharp loss of Bacteroides clonal diversity and enrichment of resistance genes that persisted for up to 2 years after treatment.

references.authors: Jesam C, Salvatierra AM, Schwartz JL, et al.
references.title: Effect of oral administration of a continuous 18 day regimen of meloxicam on ovulation: experience of a randomized controlled trial
references.finding: Meloxicam on cycle days 5-22 caused dose-dependent dysfunctional ovulation in up to 55% of cycles, yet more than 20% of women ovulated normally even on the higher dose, and cycles recovered after treatment.

references.authors: Johnston BC, Zeraatkar D, Han MA, et al.
references.title: Unprocessed Red Meat and Processed Meat Consumption: Dietary Guideline Recommendations From the Nutritional Recommendations (NutriRECS) Consortium
references.n: systematic reviews of meat and health
references.finding: The NutriRECS panel issued weak recommendations that adults continue their current unprocessed red meat and processed meat intake, judging the certainty of benefit from cutting back to be low.

references.authors: Kafi R, Kwak HS, Schumacher WE, et al.
references.title: Improvement of naturally aged skin with vitamin A (retinol)
references.finding: Retinol 0.4% applied up to three times a week for 24 weeks reduced fine wrinkles versus vehicle and raised glycosaminoglycan and procollagen I in biopsies.

references.authors: Katan MB, Deslypere JP, van Birgelen AP, et al.
references.title: Kinetics of the incorporation of dietary fatty acids into serum cholesteryl esters, erythrocyte membranes, and adipose tissue: an 18-month controlled study
references.finding: Fatty-acid incorporation half-lives differed by pool: 4.8 days for cholesteryl esters (plateau 4-8 weeks), 28 days for erythrocytes (plateau about 180 days), and adipose tissue still rising at 12 months.

references.authors: Koch HM, Bolt HM, Angerer J
references.title: Di(2-ethylhexyl)phthalate (DEHP) metabolites in human urine and serum after a single oral dose of deuterium-labelled DEHP
references.finding: After a single labelled DEHP dose, urinary metabolite excretion followed a two-phase curve with half-lives of about 2 h then 5-10 h, and 47% of the dose was recovered within 44 h.

references.authors: Kristensen DM, Desdoits-Lethimonier C, Mackey AL, et al.
references.title: Ibuprofen alters human testicular physiology to produce a state of compensated hypogonadism
references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.finding: In young men given ibuprofen, luteinizing hormone rose in proportion to plasma ibuprofen and the testosterone/LH ratio fell, producing compensated hypogonadism; testis explants showed direct transcriptional suppression of steroidogenesis.

references.authors: Lam JR, Schneider JL, Zhao W, et al.
references.title: Proton pump inhibitor and histamine 2 receptor antagonist use and vitamin B12 deficiency
references.finding: Two or more years of proton-pump inhibitors (OR 1.65) or H2 blockers (OR 1.25) was associated with vitamin B12 deficiency, more at higher PPI doses.

references.authors: La Marca A, Spaggiari G, Domenici D, et al.
references.title: Elevated levels of nitrous dioxide are associated with lower AMH levels: a real-world analysis
references.finding: Higher NO2, and weakly PM10 and PM2.5, were associated with lower anti-Mullerian hormone, with NO2 remaining associated after age adjustment.

references.authors: Lane T, de Ruijter VN, Wardani I, et al.
references.title: A QA/QC screening framework to assess studies reporting microplastic presence in human organs, tissues, and bodily fluids
references.finding: Quality-screening framework for human microplastic studies: most published reports fail basic contamination-control and identification criteria, so reported body burdens are unreliable.

references.authors: Larsen SB, Giwercman A, Spanò M, et al.
references.title: A longitudinal study of semen quality in pesticide spraying Danish farmers. The ASCLEPIOS Study Group
references.finding: Across a spraying season, sperm concentration fell similarly in pesticide-using and non-using farmers, with no exposure-related change in semen quality or hormones.

references.authors: Lauterburg BH, Mitchell JR
references.title: Therapeutic doses of acetaminophen stimulate the turnover of cysteine and glutathione in man
references.finding: Single therapeutic doses of acetaminophen (600-1200 mg) markedly increased turnover of the cysteine pool used for glutathione synthesis, showing that ordinary doses draw on glutathione.

references.authors: Li JJ, Li YS, Chu JM, et al.
references.title: Changes of plasma inflammatory markers after withdrawal of statin therapy in patients with hyperlipidemia
references.finding: Six weeks of pravastatin lowered CRP and IL-6, and both rebounded above treated levels by days 3 and 7 after abrupt withdrawal despite unchanged LDL cholesterol.

references.authors: Li DK, Ferber JR, Odouli R, et al.
references.title: Use of nonsteroidal antiinflammatory drugs during pregnancy and the risk of miscarriage
references.finding: NSAID use around conception was associated with a 1.89-fold higher miscarriage risk with a dose-response by duration, strongest for losses before 8 weeks.

references.authors: Li Y, Fletcher T, Mucs D, et al.
references.title: Half-lives of PFOS, PFHxS and PFOA after end of exposure to contaminated drinking water
references.finding: After contaminated drinking water was replaced, serum PFHxS, PFOS and PFOA fell 13%, 20% and 26% per year, giving half-lives of 5.3, 3.4 and 2.7 years, faster in women.

references.authors: Li Z, Liu Q, Xu Z, et al.
references.title: Association between short-term exposure to ambient particulate air pollution and biomarkers of oxidative stress: A meta-analysis
references.finding: Each 10 ug/m3 rise in short-term PM2.5 was associated with 1.6% higher malondialdehyde and a borderline 2.1% higher 8-OHdG.

references.authors: Li W, Long C, Fan T, et al.
references.title: Gas cooking and respiratory outcomes in children: A systematic review
references.finding: Systematic review of 66 studies concluding that the gas-cooking and childhood-asthma literature is mostly cross-sectional, poorly adjusted and too inconsistent for causal inference; the authors work for a consultancy with industry clients.

references.authors: Lilja M, Mandić M, Apró W, et al.
references.title: High doses of anti-inflammatory drugs compromise muscle strength and hypertrophic adaptations to resistance training in young adults
references.finding: Eight weeks of maximal over-the-counter ibuprofen (1,200 mg/day) roughly halved the gain in quadriceps volume from resistance training (3.7% vs 7.5%) compared with low-dose aspirin, and blunted some strength gains.

references.authors: Lin FH, Lin JY, Gupta RD, et al.
references.title: Ferulic acid stabilizes a solution of vitamins C and E and doubles its photoprotection of skin
references.finding: Adding 0.5% ferulic acid to 15% vitamin C plus 1% vitamin E doubled the solution's photoprotection of pig skin and improved its chemical stability.

references.authors: Linkens AM, Houben AJ, Niessen PM, et al.
references.title: A 4-week high-AGE diet does not impair glucose metabolism and vascular function in obese individuals
references.finding: A 4-week diet differing 2.7-5.3-fold in AGE content changed urinary and plasma AGEs but produced no difference in insulin sensitivity, vascular function, inflammation or lipids.

references.authors: Liu Z, Liu Y, Song Y, et al.
references.title: Systemic oxidative stress biomarkers in chronic periodontitis: a meta-analysis
references.finding: Chronic periodontitis was associated with lower serum total antioxidant capacity and higher malondialdehyde and nitric oxide.

references.authors: Liu J, Zhang P, Tian J, et al.
references.title: Ozone therapy for treating foot ulcers in people with diabetes
references.finding: Cochrane review of ozone therapy for diabetic foot ulcers found the evidence too sparse and low-quality to draw conclusions.

references.authors: Lu C, Toepel K, Irish R, et al.
references.title: Organic diets significantly lower children's dietary exposure to organophosphorus pesticides
references.finding: Urinary malathion and chlorpyrifos metabolites fell to undetectable immediately after organic food was introduced and stayed undetectable until conventional food came back.

references.authors: MacKeown H, Magi E, Di Carro M, et al.
references.title: Removal of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances from tap water by means of point-of-use treatment: A review
references.finding: Point-of-use activated carbon, ion-exchange and reverse-osmosis filters can remove PFAS, but only five real-life studies exist, short-chain PFAS are harder to remove, and poorly maintained carbon can release PFAS.

references.authors: Marfella R, Prattichizzo F, Sardu C, et al.
references.title: Microplastics and Nanoplastics in Atheromas and Cardiovascular Events
references.finding: Patients whose carotid plaque contained polyethylene (58%) or PVC had 4.5 times the rate of myocardial infarction, stroke or death over a mean 33.7 months after endarterectomy.

references.authors: Marklund M, Wu JHY, Imamura F, et al.
references.title: Biomarkers of Dietary Omega-6 Fatty Acids and Incident Cardiovascular Disease and Mortality
references.finding: Pooled individual-level data: higher blood or tissue linoleic acid was associated with lower total cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular mortality and ischaemic stroke.

references.authors: Melo A, Viegas O, Petisca C, et al.
references.title: Effect of beer/red wine marinades on the formation of heterocyclic aromatic amines in pan-fried beef
references.finding: Beer and red-wine marinades cut heterocyclic amines in pan-fried beef, with reductions of about 88% (beer) and 40% (wine) after 6 hours of marinating and smaller effects at 2-4 hours.

references.authors: Mensink RP, Katan MB
references.title: Effect of dietary trans fatty acids on high-density and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels in healthy subjects
references.finding: Three weeks on each diet was enough for trans fatty acids at 10% of energy to lower HDL cholesterol by 0.17 mmol/L and raise LDL relative to oleic acid.

references.authors: Meyers DG, Neuberger JS, He J
references.title: Cardiovascular effect of bans on smoking in public places: a systematic review and meta-analysis
references.finding: After public smoking bans, myocardial infarction rates fell 17% overall, and the incidence rate ratio fell a further 26% for each additional year of observation after the ban.

references.authors: Micu MC, Micu R, Ostensen M
references.title: Luteinized unruptured follicle syndrome increased by inactive disease and selective cyclooxygenase 2 inhibitors in women with inflammatory arthropathies
references.finding: Continuous periovulatory NSAIDs caused a luteinized unruptured follicle in 35.6% of cycles versus 3.4% of untreated cycles; etoricoxib was the main culprit and ibuprofen 1,600 mg/day caused none.

references.authors: Milbrath MO, Wenger Y, Chang CW, et al.
references.title: Apparent half-lives of dioxins, furans, and polychlorinated biphenyls as a function of age, body fat, smoking status, and breast-feeding
references.finding: Review of congener-specific data: adult half-lives of dioxins, furans and PCBs are mostly years to decades and lengthen with age and body fat, shortening with smoking and breastfeeding.

references.authors: Miranda-Contreras L, Gómez-Pérez R, Rojas G, et al.
references.title: Occupational exposure to organophosphate and carbamate pesticides affects sperm chromatin integrity and reproductive hormone levels among Venezuelan farm workers
references.finding: Farm workers exposed to organophosphate and carbamate pesticides had a higher sperm DNA fragmentation index than unexposed men.

references.authors: Mistry S, Eschler DC
references.title: Euglycemic Diabetic Ketoacidosis Caused by SGLT2 Inhibitors and a Ketogenic Diet: A Case Series and Review of Literature
references.finding: Two patients on SGLT2 inhibitors developed euglycaemic ketoacidosis, one after a single dose of empagliflozin and one within a week of starting a ketogenic diet.

references.authors: Mittal M, Siddiqui MR, Tran K, et al.
references.title: Reactive oxygen species in inflammation and tissue injury
references.finding: Review: neutrophil- and macrophage-derived reactive oxygen species at inflammatory sites drive endothelial dysfunction and tissue injury, and ROS and NF-kB amplify each other.

references.authors: Møller JJ, Lyngberg AC, Hammer PEC, et al.
references.title: Substantial decrease of PFAS with anion exchange resin treatment - A clinical cross-over trial
references.finding: Cholestyramine 4 g three times daily for 12 weeks lowered serum PFOS by 60% from a median of 191 ng/mL and other PFAS by 15-44%, with no serious adverse events.

references.authors: A Monikh F, Materić D, Valsami-Jones E, et al.
references.title: Challenges in studying microplastics in human brain
references.finding: Letter arguing that the reported brain microplastic concentrations are implausibly high and that pyrolysis markers for polyethylene cannot be separated from endogenous lipids without extra controls.

references.authors: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine; Health and Medicine Division; Division on Earth and Life Studies; Board on Population Health and Public Health Practice; Board on Environmental Studies and Toxicology; Committee on the Guidance on PFAS Testing and Health Outcomes
references.title: Guidance on PFAS Exposure, Testing, and Clinical Follow-Up
references.finding: NASEM clinical guidance: offer PFAS blood testing to likely-exposed patients, and for summed serum PFAS of 2-20 ng/mL advise exposure reduction plus lipid screening, with more testing above 20 ng/mL.

references.authors: Neal MS, Hughes EG, Holloway AC, et al.
references.title: Sidestream smoking is equally as damaging as mainstream smoking on IVF outcomes
references.finding: Despite similar embryo quality, implantation (12.6% vs 25.0%) and pregnancy rates (20.0% vs 48.3%) were as low in passive smokers as in active smokers compared with non-smokers.

references.authors: Negrean M, Stirban A, Stratmann B, et al.
references.title: Effects of low- and high-advanced glycation endproduct meals on macro- and microvascular endothelial function and oxidative stress in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
references.finding: A high-AGE meal cut flow-mediated dilation by 36% at 2-6 h versus 21% for an identical low-AGE meal, with parallel rises in serum AGEs and oxidative-stress markers.

references.authors: Nerurkar PV, Le Marchand L, Cooney RV
references.title: Effects of marinating with Asian marinades or western barbecue sauce on PhIP and MeIQx formation in barbecued beef
references.finding: Overnight teriyaki or turmeric-garlic marinades cut PhIP and MeIQx in barbecued beef, whereas a honey barbecue sauce raised PhIP about three-fold and MeIQx about four-fold.

references.authors: Nihart AJ, Garcia MA, El Hayek E, et al.
references.title: Bioaccumulation of microplastics in decedent human brains
references.n: decedent liver, kidney and brain samples
references.finding: Pyrolysis-GC/MS found micro- and nanoplastics, mostly polyethylene, in decedent organs, with higher concentrations in 2024 than 2016 samples and in brains of people with dementia.

references.authors: Nilsson U, Attewell R, Christoffersson JO, et al.
references.title: Kinetics of lead in bone and blood after end of occupational exposure
references.finding: Followed for 18 years after exposure ended, finger-bone lead fell with a half-time of 16 years and blood lead showed three phases with half-times of 34 days, 1.2 years and 13 years.

references.authors: Noonan CW, Ward TJ, Navidi W, et al.
references.title: Assessing the impact of a wood stove replacement program on air quality and children's health
references.finding: A community wood-stove change-out cut winter ambient PM2.5 by 30% and was followed by fewer reports of childhood wheeze, though indoor reductions varied widely between homes.

references.authors: Oates L, Cohen M, Braun L, et al.
references.title: Reduction in urinary organophosphate pesticide metabolites in adults after a week-long organic diet
references.finding: Seven days of an at least 80% organic diet lowered total urinary dialkylphosphate metabolites by 89% compared with a conventional week.

references.authors: Olsen EA, Katz HI, Levine N, et al.
references.title: Tretinoin emollient cream for photodamaged skin: results of 48-week, multicenter, double-blind studies
references.finding: Improvement in photodamage from daily tretinoin emollient cream was maintained or increased during a further 24 weeks of use, and side effects were less common in the extension than in the first 24 weeks.

references.authors: Olsen EA, Katz HI, Levine N, et al.
references.title: Sustained improvement in photodamaged skin with reduced tretinoin emollient cream treatment regimen: effect of once-weekly and three-times-weekly applications
references.finding: After 48 weeks of daily tretinoin, three-times-weekly application maintained and sometimes further improved photodamage, once-weekly did so less well, and stopping led to partial regression.

references.authors: Otsuka R, Watanabe H, Hirata K, et al.
references.title: Acute effects of passive smoking on the coronary circulation in healthy young adults
references.finding: A 30-minute exposure to environmental tobacco smoke cut coronary flow velocity reserve in healthy non-smokers from 4.4 to 3.4, showing acute coronary endothelial dysfunction.

references.authors: Pall M, Fridén BE, Brännström M
references.title: Induction of delayed follicular rupture in the human by the selective COX-2 inhibitor rofecoxib: a randomized double-blind study
references.finding: Periovulatory rofecoxib delayed follicular rupture beyond 48 h after the LH peak in 4 of 6 treated women, with no change in circulating hormones, and cycles were normal otherwise.

references.authors: Palleja A, Mikkelsen KH, Forslund SK, et al.
references.title: Recovery of gut microbiota of healthy adults following antibiotic exposure
references.finding: After a 4-day broad-spectrum antibiotic cocktail, gut microbiota recovered to near baseline within about 1.5 months, but nine common species were still undetectable at 180 days.

references.authors: Paradisi R, Vanella S, Barzanti R, et al.
references.title: Effects of indoor air purification by an air cleaning system (Koala technology) on semen parameters in male factor infertility: results of a pilot study
references.finding: A year of indoor air purification in men with unexplained infertility produced no improvement in semen parameters or reproductive hormones, with an unexplained rise in seminal leucocytes.

references.authors: Paulin LM, Diette GB, Scott M, et al.
references.title: Home interventions are effective at decreasing indoor nitrogen dioxide concentrations
references.n: homes with unvented gas stoves (3 arms)
references.finding: In a three-arm randomized trial, replacing a gas stove with electric cut median kitchen NO2 by 51% at 3 months and HEPA/carbon purifiers cut it immediately by 27%, while a ventilation hood did nothing measurable.

references.authors: Peng CY, Tsai EM, Kao TH, et al.
references.title: Canned food intake and urinary bisphenol a concentrations: a randomized crossover intervention study
references.finding: A canned-food meal raised urinary BPA by up to 206% at 4 h compared with fresh food, returning to baseline by 24 h.

references.authors: Peters A, Dockery DW, Muller JE, et al.
references.title: Increased particulate air pollution and the triggering of myocardial infarction
references.finding: Case-crossover analysis found myocardial infarction risk raised by fine particles in the previous 2 hours (OR 1.48 per 25 ug/m3) and again by the 24-hour average one day before onset.

references.authors: Pinnell SR, Yang H, Omar M, et al.
references.title: Topical L-ascorbic acid: percutaneous absorption studies
references.finding: L-ascorbic acid penetrates skin only below pH 3.5 and best at 20%; tissue levels saturated after three daily applications and fell with a half-life of about 4 days.

references.authors: Pope CA 3rd, Ezzati M, Dockery DW
references.title: Fine-particulate air pollution and life expectancy in the United States
references.n: 211 county units in 51 US metro areas
references.finding: A 10 ug/m3 fall in fine particulate matter between about 1980 and 2000 was associated with a 0.61-year gain in mean life expectancy, up to 15% of the overall gain.

references.authors: Qin P, Zhang M, Han M, et al.
references.title: Fried-food consumption and risk of cardiovascular disease and all-cause mortality: a meta-analysis of observational studies
references.finding: Highest versus lowest fried-food intake was associated with 28% more major cardiovascular events, 22% more coronary heart disease and 37% more heart failure, with high heterogeneity.

references.authors: Qu H, Guo M, Chai H, et al.
references.title: Effects of Coenzyme Q10 on Statin-Induced Myopathy: An Updated Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
references.finding: Pooled trials found coenzyme Q10 supplementation reduced statin-associated muscle symptoms, contradicting an earlier meta-analysis that found no benefit.

references.authors: Rabinowitz MB, Wetherill GW, Kopple JD
references.title: Kinetic analysis of lead metabolism in healthy humans
references.finding: Stable-isotope tracer study: lead in blood turns over with a mean life of about 35 days, soft tissue about 40 days, while the skeletal pool holds most of the body burden and turns over very slowly.

references.authors: Ramsden CE, Zamora D, Majchrzak-Hong S, et al.
references.title: Re-evaluation of the traditional diet-heart hypothesis: analysis of recovered data from Minnesota Coronary Experiment (1968-73)
references.finding: Recovered data from a 1968-73 trial showed that replacing saturated fat with linoleic acid lowered cholesterol by 13.8% but gave no mortality benefit, and a pooled analysis of five trials was also null.

references.authors: Randhawa M, Wang S, Leyden JJ, et al.
references.title: Daily Use of a Facial Broad Spectrum Sunscreen Over One-Year Significantly Improves Clinical Evaluation of Photoaging
references.finding: Daily SPF 30 broad-spectrum sunscreen improved all photoageing scores from week 12 onward, with 40-52% improvement in texture, clarity and pigmentation by week 52 (uncontrolled).

references.authors: Rangel-Zuñiga OA, Haro C, Tormos C, et al.
references.title: Frying oils with high natural or added antioxidants content, which protect against postprandial oxidative stress, also protect against DNA oxidation damage
references.finding: Breakfast fried in repeatedly heated sunflower oil raised DNA-repair gene expression and urinary 8-OHdG within the postprandial period, while virgin olive oil and antioxidant-enriched oils did not.

references.authors: Recio-Vega R, Ocampo-Gómez G, Borja-Aburto VH, et al.
references.title: Organophosphorus pesticide exposure decreases sperm quality: association between sperm parameters and urinary pesticide levels
references.finding: In a longitudinal follow-up, the most heavily organophosphate-exposed workers had the lowest total sperm counts, and sperm measures varied with season and changing exposure levels.

references.authors: Reimer C, Søndergaard B, Hilsted L, et al.
references.title: Proton-pump inhibitor therapy induces acid-related symptoms in healthy volunteers after withdrawal of therapy
references.finding: Eight weeks of esomeprazole produced clinically relevant acid-related symptoms in 21-22% of healthy volunteers in the 4 weeks after withdrawal versus 2-7% on placebo, consistent with rebound acid hypersecretion.

references.authors: Reistad R, Rossland OJ, Latva-Kala KJ, et al.
references.title: Heterocyclic aromatic amines in human urine following a fried meat meal
references.finding: After one fried-meat meal, heterocyclic amines appeared in urine and were largely excreted within 24 h, so these biomarkers reflect only the previous day's cooking.

references.authors: Restrepo BJ, Rieger M
references.title: Denmark's Policy on Artificial Trans Fat and Cardiovascular Disease
references.finding: In the 3 years after Denmark's 2004 artificial trans-fat regulation, cardiovascular mortality fell by about 14.2 deaths per 100,000 per year relative to a synthetic control.

references.authors: Ridker PM, Danielson E, Fonseca FA, et al.
references.title: Rosuvastatin to prevent vascular events in men and women with elevated C-reactive protein
references.finding: Rosuvastatin 20 mg lowered LDL by 50% and CRP by 37% and cut major cardiovascular events by 44% (hazard ratio 0.56) over a median follow-up of only 1.9 years.

references.authors: Ridker PM, Everett BM, Thuren T, et al.
references.title: Antiinflammatory Therapy with Canakinumab for Atherosclerotic Disease
references.finding: Canakinumab lowered CRP by 26-41 percentage points more than placebo and cut cardiovascular events by 15% at the 150 mg dose over a median 3.7 years, without changing lipids.

references.authors: Ritter R, Scheringer M, MacLeod M, et al.
references.title: Intrinsic human elimination half-lives of polychlorinated biphenyls derived from the temporal evolution of cross-sectional biomonitoring data from the United Kingdom
references.finding: Modelling UK biomonitoring data gave intrinsic human elimination half-lives of 15.5 years for PCB-170, 14.4 for PCB-153 and 11.5 for PCB-180, suggesting a ceiling of roughly 10-15 years.

references.authors: Rubes J, Selevan SG, Evenson DP, et al.
references.title: Episodic air pollution is associated with increased DNA fragmentation in human sperm without other changes in semen quality
references.n: 36 young men, up to 7 samples over 2 years
references.finding: Within the same men, periods of high air pollution were followed by more sperm DNA fragmentation on the sperm chromatin structure assay, with no change in conventional semen measures.

references.authors: Rudel RA, Gray JM, Engel CL, et al.
references.title: Food packaging and bisphenol A and bis(2-ethyhexyl) phthalate exposure: findings from a dietary intervention
references.finding: Three days of fresh, unpackaged food cut urinary BPA by 66% and DEHP metabolites by 53-56% compared with the participants' usual diet.

references.authors: Rueegg CS, Stenehjem JS, Egger M, et al.
references.title: Challenges in assessing the sunscreen-melanoma association
references.finding: Meta-analysis found no overall protective association between sunscreen use and melanoma in observational studies, attributing the discrepancy with trials to confounding by sun sensitivity and exposure.

references.authors: Rundek T, Naini A, Sacco R, et al.
references.title: Atorvastatin decreases the coenzyme Q10 level in the blood of patients at risk for cardiovascular disease and stroke
references.finding: Atorvastatin 80 mg/day halved blood coenzyme Q10 (1.26 to 0.62 ug/mL) by 30 days, with a significant fall already detectable at 14 days.

references.authors: Russo LM, Pilsner JR, Canty TP, et al.
references.title: Ambient air pollution during developmental windows of spermatogenesis and semen quality among an infertility treatment seeking population
references.finding: Across the 74-day spermatogenesis window, ozone during meiosis and spermiogenesis was associated with lower normal morphology, while PM2.5 and ozone during spermiation were associated with lower count, concentration and motility.

references.authors: Salmon CP, Knize MG, Felton JS
references.title: Effects of marinating on heterocyclic amine carcinogen formation in grilled chicken
references.finding: A sugar-containing marinade applied before grilling cut PhIP in chicken breast by 92-99% at all cooking times but raised MeIQx more than ten-fold at the longest cooking times.

references.authors: Sathyanarayana S, Alcedo G, Saelens BE, et al.
references.title: Unexpected results in a randomized dietary trial to reduce phthalate and bisphenol A exposures
references.finding: A 5-day catered 'low-exposure' diet unexpectedly raised urinary DEHP metabolites from a median of 284 to 7028 nmol/g because ingredients such as ground coriander and dairy were contaminated.

references.authors: Schwabl P, Köppel S, Königshofer P, et al.
references.title: Detection of Various Microplastics in Human Stool: A Prospective Case Series
references.finding: Microplastic particles of 50-500 um were detected in the stool of all eight volunteers, showing ingestion and faecal passage but giving no information on retention.

references.authors: Sehgal AR, Schuellerman P, Dolata J, et al.
references.title: Asthma Control Before and After Changing Gas Stoves to Electric Stoves
references.finding: Two to three months after gas stoves were replaced with electric, indoor NO2 fell from 21.0 to 6.3 ppb and mean asthma control score improved from 2.6 to 1.5, with fewer emergency visits (uncontrolled design).

references.authors: Selvin E, Paynter NP, Erlinger TP
references.title: The effect of weight loss on C-reactive protein: a systematic review
references.finding: Across lifestyle and surgical weight-loss studies, each kilogram lost was associated with a 0.13 mg/L fall in CRP, in a roughly linear relationship.

references.authors: Semba RD, Gebauer SK, Baer DJ, et al.
references.title: Dietary intake of advanced glycation end products did not affect endothelial function and inflammation in healthy adults in a randomized controlled trial
references.finding: Six weeks of a high- versus low-AGE diet had no effect on endothelial function or any inflammatory mediator in healthy middle-aged to older adults.

references.authors: Shetty KD, DeLeire T, White C, et al.
references.title: Changes in U.S. hospitalization and mortality rates following smoking bans
references.n: US national hospitalization and mortality data
references.finding: Using nationally representative data, smoking bans were not associated with significant short-term falls in myocardial infarction admissions or mortality, and subsampling showed large apparent increases were as common as the published decreases.

references.authors: Simpson TC, Clarkson JE, Worthington HV, et al.
references.title: Treatment of periodontitis for glycaemic control in people with diabetes mellitus
references.finding: Cochrane review: treating periodontitis lowered HbA1c by 0.43 percentage points at 3-4 months, 0.30 at 6 months and 0.50 at 12 months in people with diabetes (moderate certainty).

references.authors: Siti Hajar MH, Zulkefli S, Juwita S, et al.
references.title: Metabolic, inflammatory, and oxidative stress markers in women exposed to secondhand smoke
references.finding: Women with modest secondhand-smoke exposure did not differ from unexposed women in 8-isoprostane, oxidized LDL or inflammatory markers.

references.authors: Smith G, Roberts R, Hall C, et al.
references.title: Reversible ovulatory failure associated with the development of luteinized unruptured follicles in women with inflammatory arthritis taking non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs
references.finding: Three women with inflammatory arthritis had recurrent luteinized unruptured follicles while taking NSAIDs and ovulated normally in the cycle after stopping.

references.authors: Smith JS, Ameri F, Gadgil P
references.title: Effect of marinades on the formation of heterocyclic amines in grilled beef steaks
references.finding: Herb-and-spice marinades applied for 1 hour cut total heterocyclic amines in beef steaks grilled at 204 C by 57-88%.

references.authors: Stahlhut RW, Welshons WV, Swan SH
references.title: Bisphenol A data in NHANES suggest longer than expected half-life, substantial nonfood exposure, or both
references.finding: Urinary BPA did not fall as expected with longer fasting, implying either substantial non-food exposure, storage in body compartments, or both, with a population half-life estimate of 43 h.

references.authors: Staprãns I, Rapp JH, Pan XM, et al.
references.title: Oxidized lipids in the diet are a source of oxidized lipid in chylomicrons of human serum
references.finding: Feeding oxidized oil raised conjugated dienes in postprandial chylomicrons 4.7-fold and made the chylomicrons more susceptible to further oxidation, showing dietary oxidized lipids enter the circulation within hours.

references.authors: Strawford A, Antelo F, Christiansen M, et al.
references.title: Adipose tissue triglyceride turnover, de novo lipogenesis, and cell proliferation in humans measured with 2H2O
references.finding: Heavy-water labelling gave an adipose triglyceride half-life of 200-270 days and adipocyte half-life of 240-425 days, with de novo lipogenesis contributing about 20% of new triglyceride.

references.authors: Suez J, Zmora N, Zilberman-Schapira G, et al.
references.title: Post-Antibiotic Gut Mucosal Microbiome Reconstitution Is Impaired by Probiotics and Improved by Autologous FMT
references.finding: After antibiotics, probiotics delayed and left incomplete the recovery of the indigenous mucosal microbiome, whereas autologous faecal transplant restored it within days.

references.authors: Sun S, Zhao J, Cao W, et al.
references.title: Identifying critical exposure windows for ambient air pollution and semen quality in Chinese men
references.finding: Distributed-lag modelling put the critical windows at sperm-development weeks 6-12 for PM10, 10-11 for ozone and 0-5 for SO2, with large falls in sperm concentration and count per interquartile rise in PM10.

references.authors: Suwazono Y, Kido T, Nakagawa H, et al.
references.title: Biological half-life of cadmium in the urine of inhabitants after cessation of cadmium exposure
references.finding: Over 24 years of follow-up after cadmium pollution stopped, urinary cadmium fell with an estimated half-life of 13.6-14.2 years in men and 13.9-23.5 years in women.

references.authors: Teeguarden JG, Calafat AM, Ye X, et al.
references.title: Twenty-four hour human urine and serum profiles of bisphenol a during high-dietary exposure
references.finding: During three high-BPA meals, urinary total BPA peaked at about 2.75 h, serum concentrations were on average 42 times lower than urine, and free BPA was undetectable in blood.

references.authors: Tellez-Plaza M, Navas-Acien A, Caldwell KL, et al.
references.title: Reduction in cadmium exposure in the United States population, 1988-2008: the contribution of declining smoking rates
references.finding: Urinary cadmium, a marker of cumulative body burden, fell substantially in US adults between 1988 and 2008, and declining smoking explained a large part of the drop.

references.authors: Thayer KA, Doerge DR, Hunt D, et al.
references.title: Pharmacokinetics of bisphenol A in humans following a single oral administration
references.finding: After a single oral dose of deuterated BPA, serum conjugates peaked within 1.3 h, the terminal half-life of unconjugated BPA was about 6.4 h, and most people had excreted over 90% in urine within 24 h.

references.authors: Tonetti MS, D'Aiuto F, Nibali L, et al.
references.title: Treatment of periodontitis and endothelial function
references.finding: Intensive periodontal treatment worsened flow-mediated dilation and raised inflammatory markers at 24 hours, then improved endothelial function by 0.9% at 60 days and 2.0% at 180 days versus control care.

references.authors: Trappe TA, Carroll CC, Dickinson JM, et al.
references.title: Influence of acetaminophen and ibuprofen on skeletal muscle adaptations to resistance exercise in older adults
references.journal: Am J Physiol Regul Integr Comp Physiol
references.finding: Over-the-counter acetaminophen (4 g/day) or ibuprofen (1.2 g/day) during 12 weeks of resistance training did not blunt muscle growth in older adults and appeared to enhance it.

references.authors: van der Pols JC, Williams GM, Pandeya N, et al.
references.title: Prolonged prevention of squamous cell carcinoma of the skin by regular sunscreen use
references.finding: Eight years after the sunscreen trial ended, squamous-cell carcinoma rates remained almost 40% lower in the former daily-sunscreen group, with no effect on basal-cell carcinoma.

references.authors: Vierkötter A, Schikowski T, Ranft U, et al.
references.title: Airborne particle exposure and extrinsic skin aging
references.finding: Higher long-term exposure to traffic-derived soot and particles was associated with more pigment spots and a worse extrinsic skin-ageing score.

references.authors: Walzer D, Gordon T, Thorpe L, et al.
references.title: Effects of Home Particulate Air Filtration on Blood Pressure: A Systematic Review
references.finding: Across sham-controlled home filtration trials lasting a median of 13.5 days, systolic blood pressure fell by about 4 mmHg, with no clear modification by age, exposure level or study length.

references.authors: Wang Z, Bergeron N, Levison BS, et al.
references.title: Impact of chronic dietary red meat, white meat, or non-meat protein on trimethylamine N-oxide metabolism and renal excretion in healthy men and women
references.finding: Four weeks of red meat raised plasma and urinary TMAO about three-fold through more precursor, more microbial production and less renal excretion, and stopping red meat brought TMAO down within 4 weeks.

references.authors: Wang Y, Zhao Y, Xue L, et al.
references.title: Effects of air purification of indoor PM(2.5) on the cardiorespiratory biomarkers in young healthy adults
references.finding: One week of real versus sham HEPA filtration lowered diastolic blood pressure, exhaled nitric oxide and urinary 8-isoprostane and improved lung function.

references.authors: Watkins PB, Kaplowitz N, Slattery JT, et al.
references.title: Aminotransferase elevations in healthy adults receiving 4 grams of acetaminophen daily: a randomized controlled trial
references.finding: Starting 4 g/day acetaminophen produced ALT above three times the upper limit of normal in 31-44% of healthy adults within 2 weeks versus none on placebo.

references.authors: Weinstock MA, Bingham SF, Digiovanna JJ, et al.
references.title: Tretinoin and the prevention of keratinocyte carcinoma (Basal and squamous cell carcinoma of the skin): a veterans affairs randomized chemoprevention trial
references.finding: Topical 0.1% tretinoin for 1.5-5.5 years did not reduce basal-cell or invasive squamous-cell carcinoma (5-year rates 53% vs 54% and 28% vs 31%) or actinic keratosis counts.

references.authors: Weiss JS, Ellis CN, Headington JT, et al.
references.title: Topical tretinoin improves photoaged skin. A double-blind vehicle-controlled study
references.finding: In a vehicle-controlled trial, 0.1% tretinoin improved 14 of 15 treated faces versus none on vehicle after 16 weeks of daily use.

references.authors: Williams MJ, Sutherland WH, McCormick MP, et al.
references.title: Impaired endothelial function following a meal rich in used cooking fat
references.finding: A meal rich in cooking fat taken from a fast-food fryer cut flow-mediated dilation from 5.9% to 0.8% at 4 h, while the same meal with unused fat and a low-fat meal did not.

references.authors: Williams MJ, Sutherland WH, McCormick MP, et al.
references.title: Normal endothelial function after meals rich in olive or safflower oil previously used for deep frying
references.finding: Meals rich in olive or safflower oil used for 8 hours of deep frying raised postprandial triglycerides but did not impair endothelial function, contradicting the earlier used-fat finding.

references.authors: Wilson KM, Vesper HW, Tocco P, et al.
references.title: Validation of a food frequency questionnaire measurement of dietary acrylamide intake using hemoglobin adducts of acrylamide and glycidamide
references.finding: Acrylamide and glycidamide haemoglobin adducts correlated only moderately with questionnaire intake (r about 0.3), but within-person adduct levels were stable (ICC 0.77) in samples 1-3 years apart.

references.authors: Wittkopp S, Walzer D, Thorpe L, et al.
references.title: Portable air cleaner use and biomarkers of inflammation: A systematic review and meta-analysis
references.finding: Portable air cleaners cut PM2.5 by 61.5% on average and were associated with 7% lower CRP and 13% lower IL-6, with no detectable effect on TNF-alpha.

references.authors: Wittmaack K
references.title: The big ban on bituminous coal sales revisited: serious epidemics and pronounced trends feign excess mortality previously attributed to heavy black-smoke exposure
references.finding: Reanalysis argued that pre-ban influenza epidemics and the underlying downward mortality trend account for the Dublin coal-ban mortality drop, and that black-smoke changes alone showed no effect in non-epidemic seasons.

references.authors: Xia X, Chan KH, Lam KBH, et al.
references.title: Effectiveness of indoor air purification intervention in improving cardiovascular health: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
references.finding: Pooled RCTs showed a 2.3 mmHg fall in systolic blood pressure but no significant change in CRP or endothelial function, and the authors graded overall certainty as very low and warned against strong claims.

references.authors: Xu R, Zhong Y, Li R, et al.
references.title: Association between exposure to ambient air pollution and semen quality: A systematic review and meta-analysis
references.finding: Each 10 ug/m3 of PM10 or SO2 was associated with roughly 2-9% lower sperm concentration and total count, and PM2.5 and PM10 with small falls in motility, with no association for most gaseous pollutants.

references.authors: Yaginuma-Sakurai K, Murata K, Iwai-Shimada M, et al.
references.title: Hair-to-blood ratio and biological half-life of mercury: experimental study of methylmercury exposure through fish consumption in humans
references.finding: Volunteers ate fish to the tolerable weekly methylmercury intake for 14 weeks then washed out for 15 weeks; blood mercury half-life was 94 days crude (57 days after subtracting background) and hair 102 days.

references.authors: Yourman LC, Cenzer IS, Boscardin WJ, et al.
references.title: Evaluation of Time to Benefit of Statins for the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Events in Adults Aged 50 to 75 Years: A Meta-analysis
references.finding: Survival meta-analysis: 2.5 years of statin treatment were needed to prevent one major adverse cardiovascular event per 100 adults aged 50-75, and only 0.8 years to prevent one per 500.

references.authors: Zou R, Durkin A, de Kat A, et al.
references.title: Air pollution and anti-Müllerian hormone: the Doetinchem Cohort Study
references.n: 2,574 women, up to 5 AMH measures over 20 years
references.finding: In a long-term Dutch cohort, long-term NO2, ozone, PM10 and PM2.5 exposure showed no clinically relevant association with AMH across the reproductive lifespan or with age at menopause.

timing.summary: PFAS are the clearest example of an exposure that outlives the exposure: once in the blood they leave at roughly 13-26% a year, so serum levels fall with half-lives of 2.7-5.3 years [tleg-li2018pfas]. Nothing you change this month will be visible this month, and for a pregnancy planned within a year the body burden you already carry is essentially fixed unless you take deliberate steps to remove it.

onset.text: No acute effect to measure. Serum concentration climbs for as long as intake exceeds elimination, which is why body burden tracks years of drinking water or occupational exposure rather than recent meals [tleg-li2018pfas].

full.text: Serum levels only reach steady state after years on a constant intake, because the elimination half-life is years [tleg-li2018pfas]; this is extrapolated from the kinetics, not directly measured. The other legacy persistent organics behave the same way or worse: intrinsic human half-lives are 11.5-15.5 years for the main PCB congeners [tleg-ritter2011], and dioxin and furan half-lives run to years or decades, lengthening with age and body fat [tleg-milbrath2009].

after_stopping.text: After contaminated water was replaced, serum PFHxS, PFOS and PFOA fell 13%, 20% and 26% per year, i.e. half-lives of 5.3, 3.4 and 2.7 years [tleg-li2018pfas]. Blood or plasma donation over 12 months lowers PFOS measurably [tleg-gasiorowski2022], and 12 weeks of cholestyramine cut serum PFOS by 60% [tleg-moller2024] or 38% with colesevelam [tleg-andersson2025]; treated firefighters cleared PFOS at 41% a year versus 12% in those just observed [tleg-delaere2025].

frequency.text: Avoidance is continuous, not episodic: because elimination is so slow, each year of exposure adds to a burden that takes years to shed. For people with high measured levels, NASEM advises exposure reduction plus lipid screening between 2 and 20 ng/mL summed PFAS [tleg-nasem2022]; the drug and donation interventions are the only measures shown to speed elimination, and they take months [tleg-moller2024, tleg-gasiorowski2022].

sperm.late_start: Starting 2-4 weeks, or even 3 months, before conception changes serum PFAS by only a few percent - too little to matter. The only short-horizon option is to stop adding (filtered water, no fluorinated gear or treated textiles) and accept the existing burden.
sperm.text: A semen-quality meta-analysis found consistent associations of PFAS with lower progressive motility and more sperm DNA fragmentation [tleg-dinisio2026], but with a 2.7-5.3-year half-life a meaningful reduction needs years, not one spermatogenic cycle [tleg-li2018pfas].

egg.late_start: Nothing useful can be achieved in the last weeks before an IVF cycle; filtering drinking water still prevents further accumulation and matters for a later pregnancy and for breastfeeding.
egg.text: PFAS elimination takes years [tleg-li2018pfas], so the exposure relevant to an egg retrieved next month was accumulated over the preceding decade. Deliberate lowering (plasma donation, bile-acid sequestrants) takes 3-12 months and has not been tested for fertility outcomes [tleg-gasiorowski2022, tleg-moller2024].

timing.debate: How fast PFAS leave the body is itself contested: apparent half-lives from populations with ongoing exposure are much longer than the 2.7-5.3 years measured after exposure stopped [tleg-li2018pfas], and the untreated comparison group in a firefighter programme showed apparent half-lives of 7.3-9.4 years [tleg-delaere2025]. Whether lowering serum PFAS improves health is untested: the interventions measure only the biomarker [tleg-moller2024, tleg-gasiorowski2022].

timing.summary: Each toxic metal has its own clock, and they differ by a factor of a thousand: arsenic clears in days [tleg-buchet1981], methylmercury in about 2-3 months [tleg-yaginuma2012], lead in blood in about a month but in bone over 16 years [tleg-rabinowitz1976, tleg-nilsson1991], and cadmium over 14-24 years [tleg-suwazono2009]. Stopping an exposure therefore pays off within a week for arsenic and within a season for mercury, but barely at all within a planned pregnancy for lead and cadmium.

onset.text: Blood and urine respond quickly to intake: a single arsenic dose is 46-78% excreted in urine within 4 days [tleg-buchet1981], and blood mercury rose from 6.7 to 26.9 ng/g over 14 weeks of eating fish to the tolerable weekly intake [tleg-yaginuma2012].

full.text: Blood mercury plateaus within roughly 3-4 months of a constant fish intake (about 3 half-lives) [tleg-yaginuma2012], while cadmium and lead keep accumulating in kidney and bone for decades [tleg-suwazono2009, tleg-nilsson1991].

after_stopping.text: Methylmercury: blood half-life 57-94 days, so about 3 months to halve and ~6 months to quarter [tleg-yaginuma2012]. Lead: blood half-time 34 days but a 13-year component from the skeleton, with bone lead falling with a 16-year half-time [tleg-nilsson1991, tleg-rabinowitz1976]. Cadmium: urinary half-life 13.6-23.5 years [tleg-suwazono2009]. Arsenic: days [tleg-buchet1981].

frequency.text: For mercury the relevant quantity is average weekly intake over the preceding 2-3 months, so an occasional tuna steak matters much less than a weekly habit [tleg-yaginuma2012]. For cadmium the dominant modifiable source is smoking, and population cadmium fell as smoking fell [tleg-tellezplaza2012]; for lead and cadmium there is no schedule that clears an existing burden.

sperm.late_start: Cutting high-mercury fish 2-4 weeks before conception removes only about a quarter of blood mercury; it is still worth doing but most of the benefit needs 3-6 months [tleg-yaginuma2012]. Lead and cadmium cannot be meaningfully lowered in that time.
sperm.text: Blood mercury needs 2-3 half-lives (about 4-6 months) to fall substantially [tleg-yaginuma2012], which is longer than the 74-90 day spermatogenic cycle, so the lead time is set by metal kinetics rather than by sperm development.

egg.late_start: Switching to low-mercury fish in the month before an IVF cycle produces only a small fall in blood and follicular-fluid mercury; it does not undo years of accumulation.
egg.text: Follicular-fluid mercury above about 0.5 ug/L and higher lead were associated with lower IVF live birth [tleg-butts2021]. Mercury responds over months [tleg-yaginuma2012]; lead can even rise in pregnancy and lactation as the skeleton releases stored lead [tleg-gulson2003].

timing.debate: Crude versus background-corrected methylmercury half-lives differ almost two-fold (94 vs 57 days), and the authors argue the crude value is more practical [tleg-yaginuma2012]. Cadmium half-life estimates range from 13.6 to 23.5 years depending on sex and creatinine adjustment [tleg-suwazono2009]. Whether bone lead release during pregnancy is large enough to matter clinically is debated; the isotope work suggests about a third of maternal blood lead comes from the skeleton, more on low calcium intake [tleg-gulson2003].

timing.summary: Nobody has measured how long plastic particles stay in a human body, so no honest time course exists. Particles pass in stool within days of being eaten [tleg-schwabl2019], but whether anything is retained in tissue, for how long, and whether cutting exposure lowers a tissue burden are all unmeasured [tleg-lane2026].

onset.text: Not measured. Ingested particles appear in stool, which shows passage rather than uptake [tleg-schwabl2019]; intake has been estimated at tens of thousands of particles a year [tleg-cox2019].

full.text: Not measured. Organ concentrations were reported to be higher in 2024 than 2016 samples, which would imply slow accumulation, but the measurement method is disputed [tleg-nihart2025, tleg-monikh2025].

after_stopping.text: Not measured: there is no published human clearance half-life for micro- or nanoplastics, and no study has shown that reducing exposure lowers a measured body burden [tleg-lane2026].

frequency.text: No schedule can be justified from evidence. Avoiding bottled water is the one change with a quantified exposure difference (about 90,000 versus 4,000 particles a year) [tleg-cox2019], but no health or body-burden outcome has been measured.

sperm.late_start: Unknown: there is no measured lead time because there is no measured clearance.
sperm.text: Plastic particles have been reported in testis tissue with a correlation to lower sperm count, but this is a small autopsy series with contested methods and no timing information [tleg-lane2026, tleg-almeida2026].

timing.debate: The dispute is methodological and goes to the heart of the timing question. A widely reported study found rising micro- and nanoplastic concentrations in decedent brains [tleg-nihart2025]; a published letter argues the concentrations are implausible because the pyrolysis markers used for polyethylene cannot be distinguished from body lipids [tleg-monikh2025], an animal-tissue method study confirms that this causes false positives [tleg-almeida2026], and a quality-screening framework finds most human tissue studies fail basic contamination controls [tleg-lane2026]. The plaque-outcome cohort [tleg-marfella2024] rests on the same class of measurement.

timing.summary: Dietary pesticide biomarkers collapse within a day or two of switching to organic food and return just as fast when you switch back [tleg-lu2006, tleg-oates2014]. Any effect on sperm, in contrast, is governed by the 74-90 day spermatogenic cycle, and the one longitudinal study across a spraying season found no short-term change in semen quality [tleg-larsen1998].

onset.text: Urinary organophosphate metabolites fell to undetectable immediately - within the first day - after organic food replaced conventional food in children [tleg-lu2006]; a week of organic eating cut total dialkylphosphates by 89% in adults [tleg-oates2014] and 13 pesticide biomarkers by 60-95% in families [tleg-hyland2019].

full.text: Biomarker reduction is complete within about a week; there is no slower component, because these compounds do not accumulate [tleg-oates2014, tleg-hyland2019].

after_stopping.text: Metabolites returned to pre-intervention levels as soon as conventional food was reintroduced, within days [tleg-lu2006].

frequency.text: Benefit exists only on the days you eat low-residue food: the children's study showed the biomarker tracking the diet day by day [tleg-lu2006]. Choosing low-residue produce rather than avoiding produce is what the semen-quality data support - high-residue fruit and vegetables were not associated with better semen while low-to-moderate-residue ones were [tleg-chiu2016].

sperm.late_start: A 2-4 week start lowers current pesticide exposure within days but can only affect the last stages of sperm maturation; the mitotic and meiotic stages 1-3 months earlier are already past.
sperm.text: Occupationally exposed farm workers had higher sperm DNA fragmentation [tleg-miranda2013] and the heaviest organophosphate exposure tracked the lowest sperm counts with seasonal variation [tleg-reciovega2008], so a full spermatogenic cycle (74-90 days) is the sensible lead time even though the biomarker responds in days.

timing.debate: Occupational cross-sectional studies find worse sperm chromatin and counts with organophosphate exposure [tleg-miranda2013, tleg-reciovega2008], but the one prospective within-person study across a spraying season found sperm concentration fell equally in spraying and non-spraying farmers, with no exposure-related change [tleg-larsen1998]. The dietary evidence is biomarker-only: no trial has shown that an organic diet changes any clinical or fertility outcome [tleg-oates2014, tleg-hyland2019].
